sources.title: Sources
sources.cities: City data: GeoNames (geonames.org), CC BY 4.0 licence, modified.
sources.climate: Climate data: CRU TS v4.08, Climatic Research Unit, University of East Anglia (Harris, Jones, Osborn), via CEDA, Open Government Licence v3.0. The 1991–2020 averages were calculated by us.
sources.advisories: Travel warnings: gov.il's "Travel warnings" dataset on data.gov.il, based on publications of the National Security Council and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. We identified the level in the bar from the text.
sources.entry: Entry on an Israeli passport: collected and checked by us against the source shown for each destination.
sources.rates: Exchange rates: Bank of Israel (representative rate) for the dollar and the currencies it publishes. Other currencies: Rates By Exchange Rate API, from which we calculated the rate against the shekel. For illustration only; the rate at a bank or exchange office will differ.
sources.flights: Flight data: AeroDataBox. Your booking code isn't sent to them.
sources.airports: Airports: OurAirports (public domain), with time zones from mwgg/Airports (MIT licence).
sources.emergency: Emergency numbers: FCDO Foreign Travel Advice (GOV.UK), under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Checked and adapted by us. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
sources.missions: Israeli missions: the Foreign Ministry's "{{dataset}}" dataset (ntz-short) on data.gov.il, under {{terms}}. Foreign Ministry emergency center: gov.il.
